title: Square-cornered E-plane 90° bend of WR-90, ports across y and x: S-parameters against field superposition
source: Field superposition in the corner square, its two expansions matched to the LSE modes of both guides (A. Sieverding, F. Arndt, IEEE Trans. MTT 40(2):353–362, 1992; J. Uher, J. Bornemann, U. Rosenberg, Waveguide Components for Antenna Feed Systems, Artech House 1993), emcraft-theory's `bend::right_angle` with 2000 modes per guide (converged to about 1e-6), moved to the ports 20 mm out by e^{−2jβ·20 mm}

quantities.reason: second-order elements adapted at 10 GHz: E is singular (r^{−1/3}) at the re-entrant edge, where the passes refine (1e-3 measured)
lossless: |S21|² = 1 − |S11|² to rounding, so it errs by |S11|/|S21| δ|S11|
a lossless symmetric two-port: S21 leads S11 by 90°, so it errs as S11's phase does
reciprocal: the system is complex symmetric, so S12 = S21 to rounding
